items.source: source - the source List
items.translation: source - 源列表

items.source: Supports sorting the underlying list via a SortDefinition implementation, available as property "sort". By default, a MutableSortDefinition instance will be used, toggling the ascending value on setting the same property again.
items.translation: 支持通过 `SortDefinition` 实现来对底层列表进行排序，该功能可通过属性 "sort" 访问。默认情况下，将使用一个 `MutableSortDefinition` 实例，再次设置同一属性时会切换升序值。

items.source: Calls doSort to trigger actual sorting.
items.translation: 调用doSort以触发实际排序。

items.source: Default implementation creates a MutableSortDefinition instance. Can be overridden in subclasses, in particular in case of custom extensions to the SortDefinition interface. Is allowed to return null, which means that no sort state will be held, triggering actual sorting for each resort call.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个 MutableSortDefinition 实例。可以在子类中重写此方法，特别是在对 SortDefinition 接口进行自定义扩展的情况下。允许返回 null，这意味着不会保存排序状态，从而为每次 `resort` 调用触发实际的排序操作。

items.source:
This is mainly targeted at usage in web UIs. Typically, an instance will be
instantiated with a list of beans, put into the session, and exported as model.
The properties can all be set/get programmatically, but the most common way will
be data binding, i.e. populating the bean from request parameters. The getters
will mainly be used by the view.
items.translation: 这主要针对 Web UI 的使用。通常，实例会由一组 Bean 创建，放入会话中并导出为模型。所有属性都可以通过编程方式设置/获取，但最常见的方式是数据绑定，即从请求参数填充 Bean。Getter 方法主要由视图使用。

items.source:
The data binding names have to be called "pageSize" and "sort.ascending",
as expected by BeanWrapper. Note that the names and the nesting syntax match
the respective JSTL EL expressions, like "myModelAttr.pageSize" and
"myModelAttr.sort.ascending".
items.translation: 数据绑定名称必须命名为"pageSize"和"sort.ascending"，正如 BeanWrapper 所预期的。请注意，这些名称和嵌套语法与相应的 JSTL EL 表达式（如"myModelAttr.pageSize"和"myModelAttr.sort.ascending"）相匹配。

items.source: Default value is 10.
items.translation: 默认值为 10。
